threshold_note: pH outside 2–11.5 and flash point below 60°C are conservative phrase-discovery cues only; neither is a legal CLP classification or safe-use instruction.

rules.why: Professional use was explicitly reported.
confirm: Check that the identified use and market restriction match the marketed product.

rules.why: A mixture and one or more H classifications were reported.
confirm: Confirm the complete classification and exact Section 2.1 classification text with an authorised assessment.

rules.why: Entered H315 matches this catalogue hazard wording.
confirm: Verify the official H315 wording, jurisdiction, version and label elements.

rules.why: Entered H319 matches this catalogue hazard wording.
confirm: Verify the official H319 wording, jurisdiction, version and label elements.

rules.why: Entered H318 matches this catalogue hazard wording.
confirm: Verify the official H318 wording, jurisdiction, version and label elements.

rules.why: A mixture may require an ingredient-identity column.
confirm: A table heading does not fulfil Section 3.2 disclosure, concentration thresholds or ingredient identifiers.

rules.why: A mixture may require CAS identifier columns.
confirm: Verify which ingredient identifiers and disclosures are legally applicable.

rules.why: A substance may have an EC identifier column.
confirm: Verify product identity and applicable identifiers.

rules.why: Skin irritation classification suggests reviewing skin-contact first aid.
confirm: Medical/first-aid review for this formulation is required; soap/water is not universally suitable.

rules.why: Eye hazard classification suggests reviewing eye-rinsing instructions.
confirm: Check urgency, duration, contact-lens advice and need for immediate medical attention.

rules.why: An inhalation hazard was entered.
confirm: Fresh-air advice may be inadequate; assess urgent medical care, rescuer safety and route-specific measures.

rules.why: A skin hazard suggests reviewing contaminated clothing instructions.
confirm: Confirm removal, medical attention and safe decontamination practices.

rules.why: A fire-related physical hazard suggests reviewing firefighter respiratory protection.
confirm: Fire and smoke products, firefighting environment and suitable PPE must be assessed.

rules.why: Aquatic hazard suggests checking containment of firefighting runoff.
confirm: Check environmental risk and feasible containment measures for the location.

rules.why: The product is recorded as powder or dust-generating.
confirm: Check whether dust controls are needed for the intended use and spill procedure.

rules.why: A solid product was identified as dust-generating.
confirm: Confirm cleanup equipment and whether dry sweeping can increase exposure.

rules.why: Flammability-related input or low reported flash point suggests reviewing ignition control during spills.
confirm: Verify ignition risks using the complete classification and scenario; flash point alone does not establish CLP category.

rules.why: Volatility or inhalation hazards suggest reviewing spill ventilation.
confirm: Ventilation can require explosion-safe equipment and a site-specific assessment.

rules.why: Aquatic hazard suggests checking drain-covering precautions.
confirm: Confirm appropriate response and environmental routes for this product.

rules.why: Aquatic hazard suggests checking surface-water protection.
confirm: Confirm relevant local containment and environmental hazards.

rules.why: Liquid state suggests reviewing absorption/containment methods.
confirm: Check absorbent compatibility before using the exact source wording.

rules.why: Exposure potential suggests reviewing handling ventilation.
confirm: Confirm the engineering and task-specific controls required; the phrase is not universal.

rules.why: Flammability-related classification suggests reviewing ignition-safe equipment.
confirm: Confirm whether explosion-proof equipment is warranted and applicable zone classification.

rules.why: Volatility or flammability suggests reviewing storage ventilation.
confirm: Check ventilation, packaging, pressure, and incompatibilities.

rules.why: Volatility suggests reviewing closure of storage containers.
confirm: Do not use for pressure-generating or vented containers; verify storage and packaging compatibility.

rules.why: Dermal hazard or extreme reported pH suggests reviewing chemical gloves.
confirm: Specify compatible glove material, thickness, breakthrough time and task; pH alone does not establish skin corrosion.

rules.why: Eye hazard or extreme reported pH suggests reviewing splash eye protection.
confirm: Check actual splash risk and suitable goggles; pH screening is not an eye hazard classification.

rules.why: Serious eye or skin corrosion suggests reviewing facial protection.
confirm: Confirm whether a face shield is needed in addition to goggles.

rules.why: Skin exposure hazards suggest reviewing glove integrity checks.
confirm: Confirm exposure conditions and glove material selection.

rules.why: Airborne exposure potential suggests reviewing respiratory PPE.
confirm: Respirator choice depends on exposure measurement, controls, fit, filter and task.

rules.why: Dermal toxicity or corrosion suggests reviewing body protection.
confirm: Assess contamination scenarios and appropriate clothing and standards.

rules.why: Reported physical state is liquid.
confirm: This is a list fragment; place it under a verified physical-state field.

rules.why: Reported physical state is solid.
confirm: This is a list fragment; place it under a verified physical-state field.

rules.why: Reported physical state is gas.
confirm: This is a list fragment; place it under a verified physical-state field.

rules.why: Reported physical form is a powder.
confirm: This is a physical-form list element; verify the observed form.

rules.why: Reported colour is colourless.
confirm: This is a colour value fragment, not a completed SDS sentence.

rules.why: Both heat sensitivity and sunlight sensitivity were reported.
confirm: Confirm the specific storage stability basis and applicable temperature/light exposure limits.

rules.why: A heat-related pressure hazard was explicitly reported.
confirm: Verify pressure build-up, thermal instability and vessel-specific response.
